name: TC-310: per-location price via the $ dialog changes A only and can be reset to shared
description: At A: $ icon ('Using shared price…') → dialog 'Pricing for "<item>" at this location' → Base price 14 → row chip 'Overridden' → Save → PATCH …/location-pricing {basePriceOverride:14} → toast, icon now 'Location price: $14', chip '1 location has a different price'; B's tab and API still show 12; reopen → 'Reset to shared price' → Save → back to shared.
